title: C: Grade Calculator
description: Convert a numerical score to a letter grade (A-F) using if-else statements.

steps.title: Score to Grade
steps.description: Declare `int score = 85`. Use if-else to convert to letter grade: 90+ = 'A', 80+ = 'B', 70+ = 'C', 60+ = 'D', below = 'F'. Print 'Grade: B'.
hints: Use else if for subsequent ranges.

verification.failureMessage: Convert score 85 to letter grade and print it
